maddeler.e:
تصطلقون (form VIII)
# تَصْطَلِقُونَ (taṣṭaliqūna) /tasˤ.tˤa.li.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
# تُصْطَلَقُونَ (tuṣṭalaqūna) /tusˤ.tˤa.la.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
